picks.name: Shonky
picks.source_note: New artist discovery: self-released. Similar deep house/minimal territory to your DJ Koze and Palms Trax picks.
picks.bio: French producer known for hypnotic, hard-grooving house with detailed polyrhythms. "EP" (September 14, 2026) is a self-released four-track 12" -- Centro Sociale, Home Signal, Speak & Spell, On The Koon -- plus three digital-only bonus cuts, mastered by Marco Pellegrino at Analog Cuts.
picks.why_listen: Punishing, detail-rich deep house grooves that sit right at the house/techno line -- solid material for a driving, hypnotic stretch of a set.

picks.name: DJ Manny & DJ Phil
picks.source_note: New release on Hyperdub. Similar Chicago footwork/juke territory to your DJ Diamond and Kush Jones picks.
picks.bio: Two Chicago footwork legends, teaming up for their first duo EP on Kode9's Hyperdub. "Feature Presentation" (July 17, 2026) is four tracks -- Don't Worry, Make Me Wanna, Know How To Love, Unblockable (ft. DJ Clent) -- fusing hypersoul vocal chops, disco-flavoured juke and acid-riffed footwork.
picks.why_listen: Dense, soulful footwork from two genre veterans at the top of their game -- great source for high-energy transitions with real melodic hooks.
